label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: The sink expression response.sendRedirect(url) receives the value of 'url', which is derived from request.getSession().getAttribute("partnerCallback"). Although a protocol check (startsWith "https://") exists, it does not validate the host/domain, allowing an Open Redirect to external HTTPS sites. This constitutes a security vulnerability (often categorized under XSS/Redirection risks in SAST). Resolved sink value is untrusted session data.

evidence.note: Session attribute retrieved and assigned to url, then used in sendRedirect without host validation
